Shopska Salad (Шопска Салата)
By: Silviya
Published: Friday, July 16, 2010 - 10:39am

Ingredients




For four servings:
4 tomatoes
2 cucumbers, peeled
2 cups grated white cheese
2 green peppers
parsley
onion
salt
oil

Preparation

1 Cut the tomatoes and cucumbers into cubes.Cut peppers into this strips and put all in a large bowl. Add oil,salt and mix. Put into plates and add 1/2 cup grated cheese to each plate.Garnish with onion and parsley.

About


This is traditional Bulgarian salad recipe! You should try it!
